_comment: 'Prevent the next X arcane damage, where X is the DAMAGE DEALT BY DAMPEN' — X is what actually landed, not the printed 3, since prevention and replacement effects can change it. PREVENT_DAMAGE coerced its amount to an int at compile time, which turned any expression into 0: a shield preventing nothing. It now resolves the expression when the shield is created, after the damage above it has resolved.
